questions.q: Which of the following is an example of Software as a Service (SaaS)?
questions.e: In SaaS, the user simply uses a ready-made application over the Internet. EC2 and raw storage are IaaS, and App Engine is PaaS.

questions.q: In machine learning, training a model on a dataset in which every example has a known output label is called ______ learning.
questions.e: Supervised learning uses labelled examples, as in spam classification. Unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabelled data.

questions.q: Which type of intellectual property right protects a word, symbol or logo that distinguishes the goods of one trader from those of another?
questions.e: A trademark identifies the source of goods or services. A patent protects inventions and copyright protects creative works.

questions.q: Unauthorised copying and distribution of licensed software is called
questions.e: Software piracy is the illegal copying, use or distribution of copyrighted software. It is both unethical and punishable under the Copyright Act.

questions.q: Which Unicode encoding uses 1 to 4 bytes per character and is backward compatible with ASCII?
questions.e: UTF-8 stores the 128 ASCII characters in one byte each and others in up to four bytes. UTF-32 always uses four bytes.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT classified as e-waste?
questions.e: E-waste means discarded electrical and electronic equipment. Newspapers are paper waste, which is not electronic.

questions.q: The network of everyday physical objects fitted with sensors and software that exchange data over the Internet is called
questions.e: This is the Internet of Things (IoT). Examples are smart thermostats, wearable fitness bands and connected streetlights.

questions.q: In India, a patent is granted for a term of ______ years from the date of filing the application.
questions.e: The Patents Act, as amended in 2002, gives a term of 20 years from the filing date.

questions.q: In India, copyright in an original literary work generally lasts for the lifetime of the author plus ______ years.
questions.e: Under the Copyright Act, 1957, the term for literary, dramatic, musical and artistic works is the author's life plus 60 years.

questions.q: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the individual to whom the personal data relates is called the
questions.e: The Act calls the individual the Data Principal. The entity deciding the purpose and means of processing is the Data Fiduciary.

questions.q: Match the cloud service model in List I with its description in List II.

head: List I
List II
rows: 1. Ready-to-use application accessed through a browser
2. Virtual machines, storage and networks on rent
3. Environment to build and deploy applications

questions.e: IaaS rents basic computing infrastructure, PaaS provides a development and deployment platform, and SaaS delivers finished software.

questions.q: Under the Information Technology Act, 2000 (as amended in 2008), identity theft is dealt with in Section
questions.e: Section 66C punishes fraudulent use of another person's password, electronic signature or unique identification feature. 66F deals with cyber terrorism.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. In unsupervised learning, the training data must be labelled.
II. Overfitting means a model performs very well on training data but poorly on unseen data.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Unsupervised learning uses unlabelled data, so Statement I is false. Statement II correctly defines overfitting.

questions.q: Which form of intellectual property protection depends on keeping the information confidential and has no fixed term of protection?
questions.e: A trade secret, such as a secret formula, is protected as long as it stays confidential. Patents and copyright expire after fixed terms.

questions.q: Section 9 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 provides that processing the personal data of a child (a person below 18 years) requires
o: verifiable consent of a parent or lawful guardian
questions.e: The Act defines a child as a person below 18 years, and Section 9 calls for verifiable parental or guardian consent before a child's data is processed.
